product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding Full Bed Skirt - Soft Quadruple Pleated Ruffle - Easy Fit with 16 Inch Tailored Drop - Hotel Quality, Shrinkage and Fade Resistant (Full, White)
features: LUXURIOUS BED SKIRT - Full size bed skirt measuring 54 by 75 inches with a 16 inches drop, featuring quadruple pleating (2 at the front corners and 2 on the sides) for a crisp look
BRUSHED MICROFIBER - 100% polyester, brushed microfiber fabric skirt is not only soft, comfortable and breathable but also gives a royal look to your bedroom
PERFECT FIT – The long length coupled with smooth, clear appearance covers your bed perfectly, giving your room a neat and tidy look (Not suitable for beds with metal frame, foot board or posts)
HIGHLY DURABLE - High tensile strength makes it strong, durable and fade resistant and also, less likely to rip or tear

EASY TO CLEAN - The tight woven nature of the microfiber bed skirt naturally resist stains and water; stains can be wiped out without a trace if this is done immediately; pre-shrunk to protect against any shrinkage after washing and drying
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - Machine wash, tumble dry or iron on low temperature; do not bleach
